trigger.description: The store-local authentication root (ADR 0086 TC-D14) cannot be established or verified when an artifact-producing command runs: the workspace key directory is symlinked, readable beyond the owner, malformed, or fails its known-answer/integrity self-check. The command completes but ships the artifact unauthenticated (no footer authentication block); import then refuses native human_explicit trust for the unauthenticated artifact instead of trusting a spoofable header.
